methods.mean: Arithmetic mean of same-role per-seed paired relative gains; no pooling across roles or actors.
methods.normalization: 1 + relative target improvement/100. OFF=1; registered target=1.10.
methods.range: Minimum to maximum across registered seeds, not a confidence interval.
methods.observer_recovery: One unchanged native simulation completed after its file-stat observer failed; a separately approved supplemental seal is verified. The original failed worker status/seal are preserved.

limitations: Five worker-window KPIs retained; no extra task_latency_ms or mec_expected_gflops rescore is performed.
Missing side-effect observations remain null, not zero.
Training losses, predictions and model selection scores are not used as actual performance.
Development and holdout results are never combined into one mean.

One throughput run has an explicit observer recovery; its native simulation was not restarted, and its OS exit code is unavailable because the observer was not its parent. No successful original-worker exit is claimed. A separately pinned v2 reader-only amendment accepts legal confined tar directory headers; original failed metadata, registration, supplemental seal and certificate remain unchanged.
